verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a broad public REST surface: the Checkout API (/sessions, /paymentMethods, /payments, /payments/details), the Management API, the Product Feed API and the Agentic Cart API. Its OpenAPI specs repo is described as the 'single source of truth for every public API', and the docs cover idempotency keys, scoped API credentials, a test environment, webhooks and structured error codes, with an official MCP server wrapping these APIs for agents. Probes confirm machine-readable docs (llms.txt and .md pages); community reports point to integration complexity, not an inability to drive the product via API. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic or agentic use of the API, and an OpenAPI spec at a discoverable docs URL (the probes returned 404; the specs live only on GitHub).
